# CopyStream <img class="product" src="media/bb-20x14.png" alt="BlitzBasic" title="BlitzBasic" width="20" height="14">

<div align="center">

[Command Index](Command-Index) · [BlitzBasic](BlitzBasic) · [Streams](BlitzBasic-Streams)

</div>


```blitzbasic
CopyStream:Void src_stream:Int32, dest_stream:Int32, buffer_size:Int32=16384
```

| Parameter | Mode | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `src_stream` | In | Int32 | required | The stream to read from. |
| `dest_stream` | In | Int32 | required | The stream to write to. |
| `buffer_size` | In | Int32 | `16384` | How many bytes to move at a time. Defaults to 16384. |

## Description

Copies everything that is left in one stream into another, in pieces of `buffer_size` bytes.
